in_marathi.name: Kusumakar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kusumakar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kusuma’ meaning flower and ‘Kar’ meaning doing. The name Kusumakar signifies a person who is as fragrant and beautiful as a flower, and is always doing good deeds.
